title: Schema Inference for Interpretable Image Classification

layout.note: One rounded outer frame in three column groups: a narrow left strip ruled off by a vertical line (photo with overlay above, ingredient table below), a middle column of two stacked rounded graph boxes, and a wide right area with the Matcher arrow, a 2 by 2 set of ovals (rows Instance and Category, columns #198 and #150) and the score line.

lesson: Fix one colour per discrete concept and carry it from the image overlay through the table of examples and the graph vertices to the terms of the final score, so a prediction can be traced to its evidence. Show the matcher as a big labelled arrow between graph boxes and enlarge the matched local structures in ovals.
